captions.detailed: A compact camera flash accessory featuring a vertical rectangular body with a mounting foot at the bottom. At the top of the body, a cradle supports a wide, rectangular flash head with a front-facing transparent lens. The flash head swivels horizontally on the body, tilts vertically inside its cradle, and features a thin, rectangular white bounce card that slides out vertically from a slot in the top of the head shell.
captions.instruction: Create a compact, travel-scale camera flash accessory with a rectangular main body, a shoe mount at the base, and a swiveling/tilting rectangular flash head. Include a thin white bounce card that slides vertically out of the top of the flash head, and define realistic articulation limits for the swivel, tilt, and sliding card motion.
captions.factory: Construct the flash body from a vertical box joined to a bottom shoe mount and a cylindrical neck swivel. Build the head cradle using a horizontal box with two vertical side ears. Create the flash head as a hollowed-out box enclosing a front lens plate, and add a thin box for the sliding bounce card. Define a continuous or revolute joint for the neck swivel, a revolute joint for the head tilt axis, and a prismatic joint for the sliding bounce card.
